handback.title: Plan check locks owner tests and checks test docstrings
handback.summary: The plan check keeps the owner's tests as written and holds new tests to one docstring shape.
handback.user_story: Tests the owner commits stay exactly as written, and every new test explains itself in one shape.

acceptance_criteria.text: A plan that changes a test the owner committed is rejected, naming that test.
acceptance_criteria.words: A plan built on my tests keeps every one unchanged
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One change to one test; the owner named no other case.

acceptance_criteria.text: A plan that deletes a test the owner committed is rejected, naming that test.
acceptance_criteria.words: agents may propose more but never change or drop mine
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One deleted test; the owner named no other case.

acceptance_criteria.text: A plan that files no criterion for a test the owner committed is rejected, naming that test.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One test left out; the owner named no other case.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new or changed test with no User line in its docstring is rejected, naming the test.
acceptance_criteria.words: enforce this as a schema in test files

edge_cases.case: An older test the planner rewrites is held to the shape like a new one.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new or changed test with no Verified by line is rejected, naming the test.
acceptance_criteria.words: rigor line let's name it verified by line

edge_cases.case: An older test the planner rewrites is held to the shape like a new one.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new or changed test with no Agent paragraph is rejected, naming the test.
acceptance_criteria.words: Agent holds the full detail, uncapped and folded on cards.

edge_cases.case: An older test the planner rewrites is held to the shape like a new one.

acceptance_criteria.text: An Agent paragraph of any length that names code passes the check.
acceptance_criteria.words: Agent holds the full detail, uncapped
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Length and code are the whole behavior; nothing else varies.

acceptance_criteria.text: A User line over 15 words is rejected, naming the test and its word count.
acceptance_criteria.words: User, Verified by and Edge are short and capped
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One line over its cap; a line at the cap is the good case.

acceptance_criteria.text: A Verified by line over 15 words is rejected, naming the test and its word count.
acceptance_criteria.words: User, Verified by and Edge are short and capped
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One line over its cap; a line at the cap is the good case.

acceptance_criteria.text: An Edge line over 15 words is rejected, naming the test and its word count.
acceptance_criteria.words: User, Verified by and Edge are short and capped

edge_cases.case: A test with no Edge line passes, since the line is optional.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new test file whose opening docstring has no user line is rejected.
acceptance_criteria.words: Each test file opens with the same pair: one user line, then agent detail.

edge_cases.case: The new file has no opening docstring at all.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new test file whose opening docstring has no agent detail after its user line is rejected.
acceptance_criteria.words: Each test file opens with the same pair: one user line, then agent detail.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Only the missing detail varies; the owner named no other case.

acceptance_criteria.text: An older test left unchanged passes the check without the new docstring shape.
acceptance_criteria.words: checked by code on new and changed tests only
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: One untouched older test is the whole case.

non_functional.text: Any plain sentence passes as a Verified by line, with no list of test kinds.
non_functional.why: It must work in any repo, not only this one.
non_functional.words: it should be prose please don't use categories finetuned for our repo only that will not fly
non_functional.no_edge_cases: Several unrelated sentences are the whole case.

test_changes.tests/test_new_test_check.py::test_a_new: Sample docstrings now take the User, Verified by and Agent shape.
test_changes.tests/test_new_test_check.py::test_a_ren: A renamed test is a change, so its sample now carries the new shape.
test_changes.tests/test_word_caps.py::test_a_docstrin: First lines now open with a User label, which the 15-word cap does not count.

raises.label: Owner tests and rules
raises.text: Should your tests skip the docstring shape and must-fail rules, since no agent may fix them? The plan assumes not.
raises.evidence: The check holds every test new since main to these rules, owner commits included.
